best_lineage.idea: Reorder loops to i-k-j to enable streaming of B and C rows and enable NEON vectorization and fma operations, significantly improving data locality and instruction-level parallelism.

The loop reordering i-k-j is correct for performance, but the bug is that the inner loop does not initialize C elements before accumulation; this causes undefined behavior for n=1 where C is uninitialized, leading to large errors. Fix by initializing C to zero before computation.
